Summary: Biblical wisdom is skill for living in God's world God's way, beginning with the fear of the Lord. Proverbs, Job, and Ecclesiastes explore work, speech, money, suffering, and the limits of human understanding. In the New Testament, Christ Himself becomes for us wisdom from God, wiser than Solomon and the answer to our deepest questions.
KeyPassages: Proverbs 1:7; Proverbs 3:5-6; Job 28:28; Ecclesiastes 12:13; James 1:5; 1 Corinthians 1:30
RelatedEvents: Building of Solomon's Temple; The Birth of Jesus
